title: Across the Living Island
intro: A ten-day passage from the lagoons of Negombo to the island’s southern shore, by road, rail and river.

days.title: Arrival by the sea
days.description: Meet your transfer at Katunayake Airport. The drive to Negombo takes around 40 minutes. Leave the rest of the day open for the beach.

days.title: Into elephant country
days.description: After breakfast, drive inland for about 3½ hours. Check in before an evening jeep safari in search of elephants.

days.title: A village morning, a rock at sunset
days.description: Spend the morning on a village visit and return to the hotel. In the evening, travel about 30 minutes to Pidurangala and climb for sunset views of Sigiriya Rock Fortress.

days.title: The arts of Kandy
days.description: Allow about three hours for the drive to Kandy. Visit a spice and herbal garden, explore a gem factory and museum, and watch a cultural dance performance. A visit to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic is optional.

days.title: River water to hill air
days.description: Travel via Kitulgala for white-water rafting, then continue into the highlands. The sample allows around four hours of driving.

days.title: The hill-country railway
days.description: Transfer to Nanu Oya station and take the train to Ella. The sample allows for a breakfast-only hotel and dinner at a restaurant in town.

days.title: Stone arches and a sunset walk
days.description: Visit Nine Arch Bridge after breakfast. In the evening, walk up Little Adam’s Peak for sunset, then dine in Ella town. The second hotel night is also on a breakfast-only basis.

days.title: An evening in Yala
days.description: Drive about four hours to Yala and check in. Spend the evening on a jeep safari in Yala National Park. Wildlife sightings vary.

days.title: A stop at the Elephant Transit Home
days.description: Travel about 2½ hours to Udawalawe. The example schedules a 3 p.m. visit to the Elephant Transit Home for the calves’ milk feeding. Confirm the viewing time when planning your trip.

days.title: Choose your stretch of coast
days.description: After breakfast, travel to your choice of five beach destinations. The sample tour ends at drop-off. Any beach nights and onward airport transfer are separate arrangements.
